config.name: Severn Estuary

calibration.method: coordinate search, high water and timing at Oldbury

config._note: Bed levels are ASSUMPTIONS (mAOD) until calibrated against Oldbury. The Severn has one of the largest tidal ranges in the world and a tidal bore, which a 1D model with 500 m nodes represents only approximately. Deerhurst-to-Gloucester lag assumed. Oldbury dries at low tide (its low-water readings show the sensor level), so it is used for high water only.
